answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identities to a cryptographic attestation chain verified through recursive zero-knowledge proofs. When validation diverges, verification costs scale superlinearly as an exponential capital exhaustion mechanism, imposing quadratic fee burn on Sybil swarms.
